The '''Impact Crate''' is a special time-limited crate released in January 2015. It is more expensive than a typical crate, but contains only 3-star crate-exclusive units and up.

Cost: 120 Volt Coins per open

Contents:
* [[Cerebral]] x1 (unique to this crate)
* [[Anasi]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Manticore]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[BTP Infantry]] x2 (unique to this crate)
* [[Dampening AI]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Golem]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Copperfin]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Hound]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Shadow]] x4 (unique to this crate)
* [[Prototype Laser]] x4 (unique to this crate)
